timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I'll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you'll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let's begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: My focus keeps drifting right now.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My mind is pulling in a few directions at once.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: It's okay that my attention isn't locked in yet.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I don't have to force my focus back all at once.
I can gently bring my attention back here.
One thing at a time is enough.
I can let the distractions quiet down a little.
My focus is allowed to return in its own time.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I'm ready to give this my attention again.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. You can return to this whenever you need to.
